searchText: what does "domain" mean in the specs? domain is used to isolate signatures between different components of the spec and from different chains/forks of eth2 See https://benjaminion.xyz/eth2-annotated-spec/phase0/beacon-chain/configuration/#domain-types your annotations are very helpful <@!573787335796326400> great effort 👍 So a little while back I suggested it would be more efficient for a validator client running multiple validators that are all assigned to the one committee to produce a single aggregated attestation for all those validators instead of publishing each individual attestation. Turns out, it's explicitly forbidden to gossip aggregated attestations on the attestation subnets. I can see the advantages of both ideas so 🤷 . We're currently publishing single attestations anyway so will just leave it that way.
